title: Skipping Stones
can_do: 按“先……然后……后来……”讲一次出游的经历，并补上感受细节。
trigger: Mom asks about the lake trip she missed, and Child recounts it in order.
setting: Home again after the lake trip.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: How was the lake trip with Dad today?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: So fun! First we found big flat stones.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes! Then Dad taught me to skip them.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Did your stone jump on the water?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Three times! After that, we ate sandwiches.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Sandwiches by the water sound lovely.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: And a duck watched us eat the whole time.

replay_cards.title: The museum day
replay_cards.setting: A class trip to the science museum.
replay_cards.change: Mom asks about it at dinner.
replay_cards.challenge: Child recounts the trip in order — bus, dinosaurs, gift shop — and names his favorite moment.

replay_cards.title: The birthday party
replay_cards.challenge: Child recounts the party sequence and answers Grandma's questions about the cake and the games.

parent_support: 出游回来先问“最想讲哪一段”，从最有感觉的讲起。
用“先……然后……”帮他把顺序钉住，卡住时提示第一个词。
追一个感受问题“那时候你觉得怎么样”，让叙述有温度。
